title: The 10 Best Cordless Caulking Guns
subtitle: Battery-powered caulk and adhesive guns for trim, windows, tubs and construction adhesive, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless caulking gun drives the plunger with a motor, so you get a steady bead without squeezing a trigger hundreds of times. We ranked 10 best-sellers from DEWALT, Milwaukee, CRAFTSMAN, RYOBI and budget brands on rating, review volume and features (batteries in the box, anti-drip, speed control and a work light). Brand-name guns are bare tools; the budget kits include batteries that fit nothing else.

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Cordless Caulking Gun, 10oz, Variable Speed Trigger, Interchangeable Canister Trays, Tool Only (DCE560B)
products.verdict: The most-reviewed cordless caulk gun here: a variable speed trigger plus a dial that sets the minimum and maximum flow, anti-drip, an LED and quick-change trays for different cartridge sizes.
products.best_for: Contractors and remodelers who run a lot of caulk and adhesive.
products.skip_if: You caulk a tub once a year; it's the priciest gun here.

products.name: Milwaukee 2641-20 M18 10 oz Caulk Gun, Tool Only
products.verdict: Milwaukee's M18 caulk gun has the highest rating here at 4.8 stars and a 5-year tool warranty, but the listing gives no feature details beyond the 10 oz capacity.
products.best_for: Milwaukee M18 owners who want a pro caulk gun.
products.skip_if: You want to see features before buying; the listing bullets are filler.
cons: Listing gives no speed or anti-drip details

products.name: Milwaukee 2441-20 M12 10 oz Caulk Gun, Tool Only
products.verdict: The smaller M12 version, lighter in the hand for overhead and trim work. Like the M18 listing, it's light on details but well reviewed, with a 5-year tool warranty.
products.best_for: M12 owners doing trim, windows and bathrooms.
products.skip_if: You want specs on the page; there aren't many.
pros: M12 is smaller and lighter than 18V/20V

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Caulk Gun, Anti-Drip, Variable Speed, Tool Only (CMCE600B)
products.verdict: A CRAFTSMAN V20 caulk gun with a speed dial, anti-drip and a cartridge holder that rotates 360 degrees so the nozzle points where you need it.
products.best_for: CRAFTSMAN V20 owners caulking windows, trim and baths.
products.skip_if: You want an LED; the listing doesn't mention one.

products.name: RYOBI 18V ONE+ 10 Oz. Caulk and Adhesive Gun, Tool Only (PCL901B)
products.verdict: RYOBI's ONE+ caulk gun sells well and rates 4.6 stars, but the listing's only bullet is 'TOOL ONLY'.
products.best_for: RYOBI ONE+ owners who want a cheap powered caulk gun.
products.skip_if: You want to check features first; the listing doesn't list any.

products.name: SEESII Cordless Caulking Gun with 2 x 2.0Ah Batteries

specs.extras: 300 kg push force, up to 180 min runtime

products.verdict: The best seller here: a complete kit with two batteries, four speeds, a no-drip plunger and a claimed 300 kg of push force, for well under the brand-name bare tools.
products.best_for: Homeowners who don't own tool batteries and want a powered caulk gun ready to go.
products.skip_if: You want the batteries to work with your other tools; they don't.
pros: 500+ sold last month, the most here
Two batteries and charger in the box

products.name: SEESII Electric Caulking Gun, Brushless Motor, 2 x 2.0Ah Batteries
products.verdict: SEESII's brushless version, with stepless speed instead of four steps, a ring-shaped LED around the nozzle and a drip-proof plunger. It shares its review count with the CG100.
products.best_for: Anyone buying a kit who wants finer speed control and a light.
products.skip_if: You want separate reviews for this model; it shares them with the CG100.

products.name: Electric Caulking Gun, Cordless Caulk Gun with 2 x 2.0Ah Batteries
products.verdict: A kit with two batteries, four speeds, anti-drip and an LED aimed at the nozzle, at one of the lowest prices for a battery kit here.
products.best_for: Occasional caulking on a budget with everything included.
products.skip_if: You want a brand you can find parts for later.

products.name: Cordless Caulking Gun for Milwaukee 18V Battery, 450lm LED, 4 Speeds, Drip-Free, 10oz (Tool Only)

specs.extras: 450 lm LED, auto power cut-off at end of stroke

products.verdict: A third-party caulk gun that runs on Milwaukee M18 batteries, with four speeds, a bright 450-lumen LED and anti-drip, for much less than Milwaukee's own.
products.best_for: M18 owners who want a cheap powered caulk gun.
products.skip_if: You want Milwaukee's warranty; this isn't a Milwaukee tool.

products.name: MARSOSAUR Non-Drip Electric Caulking Gun, 300 KG Thrust, AA Battery Powered, 10oz, LED
products.verdict: The cheapest gun here runs on four AA batteries instead of a tool pack. It's light at 1.98 lb with a non-drip mechanism and constant-flow motor, and the seller lists a 10-year warranty.
products.best_for: Light caulking around the house with no tool batteries at all.
products.skip_if: You run a lot of thick adhesive; AA power and one speed limit it.

avoid.name: Electric Caulking Gun Compatible With Dewalt 20V Max Battery, 10 Oz Cordless Caulk Gun with 6 Adjustable Speed, LED Light
avoid.flag: Claims 800 kg of thrust, nearly 3 times other battery guns
avoid.verdict: A DEWALT-battery caulk gun that claims 800 kg of thrust and has the lowest rating of the guns we looked at, 3.7 stars.
reasons: It claims '800kg(±50kg) of thrust'. The other battery caulk guns here that list a figure claim about 300 kg; a 10 oz caulk tube doesn't need anything close to 800.
At 3.7 stars it's rated well below every gun on our list, including the cheaper SEESII and Uaoaii kits that include batteries.
If you're on DEWALT batteries, DEWALT's own DCE560B has 1,816 reviews and 4.5 stars.

buyers_guide.q: Is a powered caulk gun worth it?
buyers_guide.a: If you caulk more than a few tubes at a time, yes. A motor pushes the plunger at a steady rate, so beads are more even and your hand doesn't cramp on thick adhesives or cold silicone.
When you release the trigger, the plunger backs off slightly so caulk stops flowing instead of oozing out of the nozzle. It saves mess on finished surfaces.
Yes for mixed jobs. Slow speeds give a thin bead on trim; fast speeds move thick construction adhesive. Single-speed guns like the AA-powered MARSOSAUR work best on standard 10 oz tubes of caulk.

buyers_guide.q: Will it take sausage packs or 29 oz tubes?
buyers_guide.a: Most guns here take standard 10 oz cartridges only. DEWALT's DCE560B has interchangeable trays for other canister sizes.

If you own DEWALT, Milwaukee, CRAFTSMAN or RYOBI batteries, the bare tool keeps you on one platform. If not, the SEESII and Uaoaii kits include two batteries and a charger for less than most bare brand-name guns.
